name: dev-loop
description: The virtuous development loop for Rails. Opus plans, a parallel Sonnet specialist army implements (via roundhouse), Codex adversarially reviews, a fresh Opus reviewer rates the work against the plan, Sonnet agents fix until an 8.5 quality gate passes, learnings are captured, and a PR is opened. Wraps @kurenn/roundhouse and @openai-codex/codex.
